visual_comparison.method: Direct sRGB metrics over the identical 1280x720 breaking_water_side camera. The measured bank band is rows 140 through 259. Green dominance requires G-max(R,B)>0.04; edge fraction uses adjacent-pixel luminance-gradient magnitude >0.08.
visual_comparison.verdict: Retain as a bounded technical shoreline improvement. The corrected bank-face tuning visibly replaces part of the barren upper bench with short cover and irregular rock silhouettes, materially increasing green coverage and bank-edge breakup without changing terrain or river physics. The lower wet-bank bench, plant forms, geology, terrain detail, forest, atmosphere, and water remain visibly procedural, so photoreal acceptance stays rejected.
